properties.displayName: Asset Entity ASIM filtering parser for Microsoft Sentinel native Asset Entity table
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null), endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    entityid_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), entityname_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    assettype_in:string='*', path_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    assetowner_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), entitysource_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    disabled:bool=false, pack:bool=false) {
  ASimAssetEntityLogs
  | where not(disabled)
  | where isnull(starttime) or coalesce(EntityIngestionTime, TimeGenerated) >= starttime
  | where isnull(endtime) or coalesce(EntityIngestionTime, TimeGenerated) <= endtime
  | where array_length(entityid_has_any) == 0 or EntityId has_any (entityid_has_any)
  | where array_length(entityname_has_any) == 0 or EntityName has_any (entityname_has_any)
  | where assettype_in == '*' or AssetType =~ assettype_in
  | where array_length(path_has_any) == 0
      or FilePath has_any (path_has_any) or SitePath has_any (path_has_any)
  | where array_length(assetowner_has_any) == 0 or AssetOwnerId has_any (assetowner_has_any)
  | where array_length(entitysource_has_any) == 0 or EntitySource has_any (entitysource_has_any)
  | extend
      EntitySchema = "AssetEntity",
      EntityUpdatedTime = coalesce(EntityUpdatedTime, TimeGenerated),
      EntityIngestionTime = coalesce(EntityIngestionTime, TimeGenerated),
      AssetPath = coalesce(FilePath, SitePath),
      User = AssetOwnerId,
      AdditionalFields = iff(pack, AdditionalFields, dynamic({}))
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EntitySchema, EntitySchemaVersion, EntityUpdatedTime,
      EntityIngestionTime, EntityKey, EntityId, EntityIdType, EntityOriginalId,
      EntityName, EntityNameType, AssetType, AssetOriginalType,
      EntityVendor, EntitySource, EntityOriginalSource, EntityProduct, EntitySubProduct,
      EntityCreatedTime, EntityLastAccessedTime, EntityLastModifiedTime,
      EntityIsDeleted, EntityFeedType, EntitySnapshotId,
      AssetOwnerId, AssetOwnerIdType, AssetOwnerType, AssetOwnerScope, AssetOwnerScopeId,
      AdditionalAssetOwners, AssetOriginalPermissions, AssetOriginalRiskDetails,
      AssetRiskName, AssetRiskLevel, AssetOriginalRiskLevel,
      AssetRiskFirstReportedTime, AssetRiskLastReportedTime,
      AssetSensitivityLabel, AssetOriginalSensitivityLevel, AssetIsProtectedByDlp,
      AssetRelatedIndicators, AssetOriginalDataClassificationType,
      AssetClassificationLastScanDateTime, AADTenantId,
      IdentityDirectoryName, IdentityDirectoryId, InternalUsersCount, ExternalUsersCount,
      FilePath, FileSize, FileMD5, FileSHA1, FileSHA256, FileSHA512, FileExtension,
      FileIsSignatureValid, FileSignatureDetails, SitePath, SitePrimaryUri,
      AssetPath, User, AdditionalFields
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, entityid_has_any=entityid_has_any,
    entityname_has_any=entityname_has_any, assettype_in=assettype_in,
    path_has_any=path_has_any, assetowner_has_any=assetowner_has_any,
    entitysource_has_any=entitysource_has_any, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
